name: SH-IP1005 Bàn điều khiển (USB)
summary: Power supply and communication by USB port directly
3D PTZ control and 2 joystick control buttons
Up to 15 programmable buttons are available
Support digital tube to display the input content
Support indicators to show the operation status of keyboard
Compatible with a various kinds of client software and platform software
description_html:
Power supply and communication by USB port directly

3D PTZ control and 2 joystick control buttons

Up to 15 programmable buttons are available

Support digital tube to display the input content

Support indicators to show the operation status of keyboard

Compatible with a various kinds of client software and platform software

Support USB HID protocol.
